home.title: Lucas Justine
home.lead: I build web applications end to end, with a preference for the back end. Here you’ll find my projects and the technologies I work with.

about.title: About
about.p1: An engineering graduate from ENSIIE, I’m a full-stack developer. I’m more comfortable on the back end (APIs, business logic, databases) than on the front end, but I can build a complete application, interface included.
about.p2: I keep learning the technologies most widely used in the industry to stay up to date: right now, I’m learning Spring Boot and Angular.

aca.title: Airfield pavement applications
aca.details: ACA is an application dedicated to the management and calculation of airfield pavements
aca.body: Redesign of the application during my work-study placement at STAC. The application is developed with Laravel

booking.title: Room booking
booking.details: Room booking with a shared calendar
booking.body: Room booking with a shared calendar. Conflicts are detected before confirmation and a reminder is sent by email.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.details: Portfolio built with Angular and Tailwind CSS.
portfolio.body: The site you are on right now, built with Angular and Tailwind CSS.

parcoursup.title: Parcoursup app
parcoursup.details: Android app to browse Parcoursup programs, with 2024 statistics, favorites and an interactive map.
parcoursup.body: Modern Android app written in Kotlin to browse Parcoursup programs. It offers search with a field filter, detailed 2024 statistics (admission rate, gender and baccalaureate breakdown, honors), a map of institutions and favorites stored locally

trains.title: Train booking
trains.details: Train search and booking platform: REST API, booking service and Java client.
trains.body: Web services project made of a REST API (TrainB) to manage trains and schedules, a booking service (BookingService) deployed on Tomcat 9, and a Java client to search a journey by station, date and time, then book it. Data is stored in SQLite and the API is documented with OpenAPI.

ihm.title: Student group management
ihm.details: Java desktop app to manage student groups.
ihm.body: Human-computer interaction project in Java dedicated to managing student groups.

jsonInspector.title: JSON Inspector
jsonInspector.details: Java program that displays a JSON file in a readable way, in a GUI or in the console.
jsonInspector.body: JSON inspector in Java. Started without arguments it opens a graphical window; with a URL as argument it prints the formatted JSON in the console. Colors and window size are set in a configuration file.

kickoff.title: Kickoff Matchup
kickoff.details: A platform in development for organizing matches between amateur football teams. The authentication foundation is in place.
kickoff.body: Kickoff Matchup is a platform in development for organizing matches between amateur football teams. The authentication foundation is in place. The back end is made up of Spring Boot microservices: a gateway acting as a BFF, a JWT authentication service, and an email service that consumes messages from RabbitMQ. Match organization between teams is the next step.
